messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — Priority: P2 — Billing metering anomaly detected in eu-west-1. Symptoms: delayed token emits + occasional duplicate counts => some customers received overage flags. Start: 2026-03-13 03:14 UTC. Runbook: <https://go/redwood/runbooks/metering-anomalies>

billing-sre: ack, I'm taking this. Initial glance: emitter service showing retry bursts around 03:10-03:12 UTC, causing duplicate writes into the tally pipeline.

sarah_v: @billing-sre how many customers flagged? any customer-visible billing spikes yet? :eyes:

billing-sre: quick query: `SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens) FROM billing_events WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-13T03:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-13T03:20:00Z' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY sum(tokens) DESC LIMIT 20;` returned 11 tenants with anomalous +7-14% token deltas compared to baseline.

raj_p: posting relevant log snippet:
```
[03:11:04 UTC] emitter: write failed, retrying (attempt=1) id=abc123
[03:11:04 UTC] emitter: write succeeded id=abc123
[03:11:04 UTC] emitter: duplicate-detected id=abc123 origin=replay
```
Looks like a race in the ack path.

mike_o: oncall ack. Can we silence automated overage alerts while we triage so CS isn't flooded? @cs-ops

cs-ops: yep we can throttle outbound overage emails. holding until you say otherwise.

billing-sre: toggling alert flag now -> `ffctl set alerts.overage_emails eu-west-1 false` — done :white_check_mark:

emma_c: noted. CS team notified and standing by for customer comms. If we need to roll back alerts completely, say the word.

billing-sre: Mitigation plan:
1) mute overage emails (done)
2) disable emitter retry loop on canary (eu-canary) to prevent new duplicates: `systemctl restart emitter --no-retries` on canary
3) run dedupe/backfill job for 03:00-03:30 window
4) validate backfilled counts against ledger

raj_p: I've kicked off backfill job `backfill-v2 --start 2026-03-13T03:00Z --end 2026-03-13T03:30Z --dedupe` (job id bf-17985). ETA ~18m.

sarah_v: customer impact? any billing charges already posted to invoices/alerts that won't be auto-reversed?

billing-sre: invoices haven't closed for affected customers yet; emails were sent by a monitoring rule (not invoice generation). We need to reconcile and re-notify only if post-backfill confirmed spike remains.

mike_o: handing off to me in 30m. @billing-sre you ok to escalate to infra if dedupe job errors? I'll be primary after 03:45 UTC.

billing-sre: yes, if bf-17985 fails I'll page infra and post here. Currently logs look healthy on the dedupe job subtask (shard 3 progressed to 65%).

incident-bot: NOTE: Postmortem required for any P2 with customer-visible alerts. Tag: billing, infra, cs.

raj_p: bf-17985 completed. Summary: dedupe removed ~9% of tokens for affected windows; re-run of aggregation shows counts back to baseline for 9/11 tenants, 2 tenants show persistent +2-3% which looks legit (higher usage).

billing-sre: re-enabled alerts for eu region with suppression window for 03:00-03:30: `ffctl set alerts.overage_emails eu-west-1 true --suppress-from 2026-03-13T03:00Z --suppress-to 2026-03-13T03:30Z` done.

emma_c: CS: we'll send a targeted note to the 11 tenants explaining false-positive alerts and that we've reconciled counts. Draft ready for review.

sarah_v: good. Any follow-up action items?

billing-sre: action items:
- billing team to root-cause emitter ack race (owner: raj_p)
- infra to review consumer ACK semantics (owner: mike_o)
- cs to send communications (owner: emma_c)
- postmortem doc (owner: billing-sre)

mike_o: taking infra action. I'll spin up a reproducible test for emitter retries + ack ordering. Handoff complete to me at 03:45 UTC. :handshake:

sarah_v: thanks team. Closing on-call thread: incidents channel will keep the postmortem link when ready. No confirmed chargeable invoices; customer impact limited to alert noise. :tada:

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS -> mitigated. Follow-up: create postmortem within 72h and link here.
